featured_reviews.name: Om Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:

Even after I personally found the technician and explained the issue properly, he barely looked into it. We politely asked for either a refund or at least some game compensation since we had already spent so many points on that game and clearly know how to use it. But instead of helping, the technician arrogantly replied, “Who told you to play this game?” and “Don’t play this game.”

Seriously? Then why keep the game active if customers are not supposed to play it?

We even purchased a Gold Card worth ₹10,000 from the reception, expecting premium service, but instead got rude behavior and zero accountability. Rather than solving the issue, your staff questioned us for playing the game itself. Absolutely unbelievable.

I have visited many Timezone venues like Oberoi, Inorbit, R-City, Capital Mall, Growel’s, etc., and never experienced such pathetic customer service anywhere else. This branch has completely ruined the experience for me and my nephew.

The Venue Head, Prabhat, seriously needs to look into the behavior and attitude of the staff here. Customers are spending money to enjoy, not to get insulted for using the games available at the venue.

Truly disappointing. Negative rating from my side.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.

featured_reviews.name: Hargun Gujral
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at HopUp Mumbai was truly outstanding and memorable. From the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was vibrant, welcoming, and full of positive energy. The staff was friendly, attentive, and ensured that everything was well organized throughout the visit. The activities were exciting, engaging, and provided a perfect mix of fun and adventure. The facilities were clean, well maintained, and designed to offer a comfortable experience for everyone. Whether visiting with friends or family, HopUp Mumbai creates an enjoyable environment that leaves a lasting impression. I highly recommend HopUp Mumbai to anyone looking for a fantastic experience.

featured_reviews.name: SHREYAS KAPDOSKAR
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing time at HopUp Mumbai! The place is super energetic and packed with fun activities — from trampolines and bowling to VR games and arcade zones. Everything felt well-maintained and exciting, making it a perfect spot to hang out with friends or family. The staff was friendly and helpful throughout, and the atmosphere was full of positive vibes. Definitely one of the best indoor entertainment spots in Andheri for a fun-filled day. Highly recommended if you want a mix of adventure, gaming, and great memories! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.name: Grishm Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great time at Hopip Mumbai! The bowling and game machines were really fun, and the place had a great vibe. The games were entertaining, well-maintained, and enjoyable with friends and family. The atmosphere was energetic, and it made for a fun outing. Bowling was especially exciting, and there were enough game options to keep everyone engaged. Overall, a nice place to chill, have fun, and make good memories. Would definitely visit again!”

featured_reviews.name: Kabir Sajid
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience at Hopup Andheri! The place has such a fun and energetic vibe, perfect for hanging out with friends or just unwinding after a long day. The bowling setup is genuinely impressive — the lanes are well-maintained, smooth, and make the whole experience feel premium and enjoyable. What really made the visit stand out, though, was the people. A special shoutout to Komal, who was incredibly friendly, helpful, and made sure everything ran smoothly for us. The staff overall is warm, attentive, and always ready to assist, which adds so much to the overall experience. Whether you’re a beginner or someone who bowls often, this place makes you feel comfortable and excited to play. Definitely one of the best spots in Andheri for bowling and good vibes — highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Ojaswini Tamore
featured_reviews.review_text: Really enjoyed my time at Hopup Mumbai! The bowling experience was smooth and fun, and the game machines added even more excitement. There were plenty of games to play, which made the visit entertaining from start to finish. The place had a lively atmosphere, and everything felt organized and enjoyable. A good spot to spend quality time with friends or family. Looking forward to visiting again!
